steps.title: Name the roll
steps.body: In the script, declare a function named rollDie. It does not need to return the right number yet.

steps.title: Return 1 through 6
steps.body: Use Math.random and Math.floor so rollDie returns 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. The functions article has the shape. The arithmetic is yours.

steps.title: Show the roll
steps.body: Listen for a click on the button with id roll. Call rollDie and put the number in the paragraph with id result.
